zechariah.3.p1.b1.text: Then the angel showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, with Satan standing at his right hand to accuse him.

zechariah.3.p1.b2.text: The LORD rebukes you, Satan! Indeed, the LORD, who has chosen Jerusalem, rebukes you!

zechariah.3.p1.b3.text: Is not this man a firebrand snatched from the fire?

zechariah.3.p1.b4.text: Now Joshua was dressed in filthy garments as he stood before the angel.

zechariah.3.p1.b5.text: Take off his filthy clothes! … See, I have removed your iniquity, and I will clothe you with splendid robes.

zechariah.3.p1.b6.text: Let them put a clean turban on his head.

zechariah.3.p1.b7.text: So a clean turban was placed on his head, and they clothed him, as the angel of the LORD stood by.

zechariah.3.p2.b1.text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says … If you walk in My ways and keep My instructions, then you will govern My house and will also have charge of My courts …

zechariah.3.p2.b2.text: Hear now, O high priest Joshua, you and your companions seated before you

zechariah.3.p2.b3.text: I am going to bring My servant, the Branch.

zechariah.3.p2.b4.text: See the stone I have set before Joshua; on that one stone are seven eyes.

zechariah.3.p2.b5.text: Behold, I will engrave on it an inscription … and I will remove the iniquity of this land in a single day.

zechariah.3.p2.b6.text: On that day … you will each invite your neighbor to sit under your own vine and fig tree.
